summary: Qualification passed every deterministic and semantic case.

requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor report explains that the canonical declaration used `find_order` while the closed Cloudflare Think tool map uses `lookup_order`. This is corroborated by `src/agent.ts`, where `getTools()` returns `{ lookup_order: lookupOrderTool }`, and by the Git diff replacing `name: find_order` with `name: lookup_order`.

`moldea/moldea.yaml` now declares `name: lookup_order`, exactly matching the key returned by `SupportAgent.getTools()`. The approved Git diff shows this as the sole edit, and deterministic post-actor validation is valid with no failures or wiring diagnostic.

The manifest still binds runtime agent `SupportAgent` and instruction loader `loadSupportInstruction` in `src/agent.ts`, implementation `lookupOrder` in `src/implementations.ts`, registration `lookupOrderTool` in `src/tools.ts`, and both lookup schemas in `src/contracts.ts`. Source inspection confirms the registration uses those schemas and implementation. Workspace hashes show every source and instruction file unchanged, no agent schema was added, and deterministic validation and typechecking passed.

cases.title: Preserve the Cloudflare Think static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml retains SupportAgent and loadSupportInstruction bindings, declares runtime-selected-tools unresolved, and contains no partial support tool registration. src/support-agent.ts confirms getTools() combines supportStatusTool with an open runtime-selected spread.

The step-support manifest entry binds only StepSupportAgent and adds a helper-built-session-instruction warning; it does not bind loadStepSupportInstruction. src/step-support-agent.ts confirms configureSession() delegates to configureSupportSession().

The manifest preserves delegate_support description, implementation, registration, input schema, and output schema bindings without handoff or routing metadata. The Git diff adds only runtime guidance to delegating-support, while src/delegation-tool.ts and src/delegation.ts confirm ordinary function-tool delegation.

src/workflow-agent.mts still exports RuntimeInitializedAgent with the executable Date.now() field, while targeted manifest inspection finds no RuntimeInitializedAgent or workflow-agent registration. Workspace assertions show the source file is byte-identical before and after.

Support and step-support both reference /moldea/runtimes/cloudflare-agents.md. Targeted runtime-directory inspection finds it is the sole runtime guide, and its content covers open tools, helper-built sessions, ordinary delegation, initialized fields, Cloudflare Durable Object bindings, SQLite-backed migrations, and deployment configuration.

moldea/moldea.yaml contains separate warning-level unresolved records for SupportAgent's runtime-selected tool registry and StepSupportAgent's helper-built session instruction. Each includes a focused description, concrete resolution criteria, and relevant source paths.
